title: Program traced to Dachau: vanished children in gas chambers

tellings.quote: I think it started at Dhaka. I think it started in the camps

plain: A secret program involving children who vanished, which he links to the gas chambers, began in the Nazi camps such as Dachau in the 1940s, according to Whitley Strieber, a man who says he has met aliens living among us. Strieber offers this to Michels as his own belief ("I think it started in the camps") without naming a source. He does not spell out the program in detail, but if he is right it would trace its roots back to Nazi Germany.
